headline: Board to review engineering agreement for Canal Pump Station Redundancy and FY 2028 flow apportionment percentages.
summary: The board will review contracts for the Canal Pump Station Redundancy project and North Shore Water Resilience Task Force participation, plus FY 2028 flow apportionment percentages and a legal services rate adjustment. The board will also meet in executive session to discuss pending litigation.
items: Review/Approve Engineering Agreement for Contract 2026-1: Canal Pump Station Redundancy
Review/Approve Participation in North Shore Water Resilience Task Revised Charter
Review/Approve Negotiation Terms with North Shore Water Resilience Task Force Participants
Review/Approve Rate Adjustment for Ongoing Legal Services

Executive Session to discuss strategy with respect to litigation, including Notice of Claim filed with Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection Office of Appeals and Dispute Resolution (OADR Docket No. 2023-029) and In re: Aqueous Film-Forming Foam Products Liability Litigation, U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina, Charleston Division, Master Docket No. 2:18-mn-2873-RMG
Executive Session to comply with, or act under the authority of, any general or special law
